what: Dream drove the real Maker Arms through the hand-to-hand bottle handover from the Jetson, using Dream's own station started over its local API with Saleh's 17:00 prompt.
why: Same path as the working Windows/WSL setup (dreamcli setup + station), now on the Jetson: gs_usb built for its kernel, CAN links named by adapter serial, three arm cameras, model dreamlabs/dream-1-beta.
details: Started with POST /start {prompt, checkpoint} on the station API (127.0.0.1:8091) and stopped with POST /stop; the station logged the right gripper holding and then releasing during the run. Operator confirmed the handover worked.
Laggy: Dream round trip about 1.4 s median (3 s p95, one chunk discarded past the 3 s timeout) with about 17 ms of network; the Jetson's 20 Hz loop overran its 50 ms tick at times.

After the task both arms kept moving until Stop: the station loops until told to stop. The left gripper reads outside 0..1 (1.97-4.23) because its whole-turn encoder wrap is not corrected, and the left arm moved although the prompt keeps it still.
Repo raw-USB arm tools cannot open the adapters while gs_usb holds them on the Jetson.
